primary_metric: quality selection uses terminal stable 15 cm plus contact and palm-relative transport; baseline comparability separately uses the reference Isaac goal-region criterion

evidence.task_statement: requires maximizing trajectory replay success but gives no numeric lift threshold
evidence.reference_code: the Isaac main evaluator places the goal 0.30 m above the support surface and latches success when object-goal distance is <=0.15 m or object height reaches the goal; scripts/test_success_all.py is a separate MuJoCo helper
evidence.reference_behavior: the Isaac success flag is cumulative, so a later slip does not revoke a previous goal-region hit
evidence.project_correction: report the reference cumulative criterion for comparison and keep terminal 15 cm, contact, drop and palm-relative slip as a separate quality metric

wuji.baseline_validity: not eligible despite higher physics replay count because formal_v1 contains reverse distal flexion; selected anatomy-corrected method is 448 stable and 429 transport-quality

interpretation: the task statement gives no numeric height. Reference-goal and stable-quality metrics answer different questions and must be reported separately; changing the quality threshold from 30 cm to 15 cm only modestly changes counts because most successful trajectories lift close to 35 cm while most failures never establish a terminal grasp
